free_tier.stated: Unlimited storage for public, non-embeddable videos; 3 GB total for embeddable and non-public videos. This is a 2024-onwards rewrite of the old '500 MB/week' rule. The weekly quota now applies only to legacy paid Plus/Pro accounts, not Free.

retention.stated: The killer is not quota, it is that Vimeo deletes exactly the thing you want to store: 'your source file will be permanently deleted if you are a Free or Basic member'

egress.terms: Unlimited bandwidth for public non-embeddable videos; 1 TB/month for embeddable and non-public. No per-GB charge on Free.

record.tooling: The yt-dlp tool includes a Vimeo extractor that requires authentication cookies for protected content. Vimeo API v3 exposes `/me/videos`, but direct binary download links require paid subscriptions.
record.chaining: Unlimited public videos x unlimited free accounts. In principle unbounded capacity at zero cost. The only thing stopping it is the original-file problem below.
record.limits_note: ~200 GB per file advised for a successful upload, and no video longer than 24 hours. That 200 GB/file is genuinely large.
record.reliability_note: The killer is not quota, it is that Vimeo deletes exactly the thing you want to store: 'your source file will be permanently deleted if you are a Free or Basic member'. Free accounts also cannot enable downloads at all, so there is no supported retrieval path.

evidence.proved: 'unlimited public videos ... Embeddable and non-public videos are limited to 3 GB'; '1 TB of bandwidth per month'
'your source file will be permanently deleted if you are a Free or Basic member'
'Plan type: Free and Basic members cannot enable video downloads. They also cannot download videos from their own account.'
'files are kept within 200 GB ... no videos longer than 24 hours'
Free plan: unlimited public videos; 3 GB Managed storage for embeddable and non-public videos; free forever
evidence.quote: Vimeo is free, with unlimited public videos and no ads. Embeddable and non-public videos are limited to 3 GB of Managed storage, and the plan stays free forever for active accounts.

evidence.proved: 200 GB per-file advice and a 24-hour video length limit remain on the upload page
evidence.quote: We advise that files are kept within 200 GB for a successful upload. We also do not support uploads of videos longer than 24 hours.

evidence.proved: Free members' source files are permanently deleted by default
evidence.quote: By default, your source file will be permanently deleted if you are a Free member or if you are a paid member but haven't enabled source file storage in your account settings as described above.

record.notes: Unlimited storage for public, non-embeddable videos; 3 GB total for embeddable and non-public videos. This is a 2024-onwards rewrite of the old '500 MB/week' rule. The weekly quota now applies only to legacy paid Plus/Pro accounts, not Free.
